areas.description:
The rooms this person has (`docs/specs/access.md` §1): outside them, nothing in the home
exists for them. Absent means the whole home, which is what every file written before
rooms means. An empty list is a person with no rooms. An owner has none: the whole home
is what being an owner is.

AreaId.description: Format of a slug (area id): lowercase letters a-z and digits, in words separated by single `_`. 1-64 characters.

Name.description: A human-readable name. 1-100 characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.

oneOf.description: Runs the home: everything, including who else is let in.

Uses the home: sees and controls what is theirs. The whole home, unless they have been
given some rooms (`User::areas`).

UserId.description: Format of a slug (user id): lowercase letters a-z and digits, in words separated by single `_`. 1-64 characters.
